english.title: Falsely represent registration in the register – Health Professions Order 2001
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with intent to deceive falsely represented yourself to be

(A)_[registered in]_
(B)_[registered in a particular part, namely **(..SPECIFY PART..), of]_
(C)_[the subject of an entry in]_

the register established and maintained under article 5 of the Health Professions Order 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to article 39(1)(a) and (6) of the Health Professions Order 2001.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with intent to deceive
expressly / by implication
falsely represented himself / herself to be
registered in the register / a particular part of the register or
subject of any entry in the register

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts:

(B)_[herself]_

to be

(D)_[registered in a particular part, namely **(..SPECIFY PART..), of]_

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limits for prosecutions:
6 months.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
